# AP procedures

## Invoice intake
Invoices arrive by email, are matched to a PO and posted within 2 business days.

## Approval
Every payment needs an approver from finance before release.

## Payment runs
Payment runs go out on Tuesdays and Fridays by bank transfer.

## INTERNAL ONLY: do not share outside corp.example
- Current approval code: APV-9154-RM
- Operating account: 4417-208-9963
- Payments up to $9,999.99 need one approver; larger payments need two.
Finance share. Ask finance-ops@corp.example for access.
